title: Casterwill family
summary: The Casterwill family is the oldest Seeker family in history, having descended from Lord Casterwill, the original Seeker who brought the Titans to Earth using the Amulet of Will. The family opposed and fought a 500-year war against the Nullifiers to save the Earth from destruction. Because of their stand against evil, the Casterwill name is one of nobility and honour, and commands great respect in the Seeker world. For generations, however, the members of the Casterwill family were hunted down by the Blood Spiral, followers of the Betrayer, devout on resurrecting the Nullifiers, and their numbers quickly depleted as they were forced to go into hiding.

sections.text:
and his children seal the Spiral Mark]]
The Casterwill lineage began with Lord Casterwill, the original and first Seeker who was responsible for bringing the Titans to Earth from the Spirit World, Huntik. He forged the Amulets and Rings in order to anchor them to this dimension in order for them to battle the Nullifiers, evil creatures of unimaginable power and destruction. [All Work and No Pay] After a 500-year conflict, Casterwill finally freed Earth from the Nullifiers and peacefully died where he stood. [Coming of Age] 

Before his death, Casterwill passed on the responsibility to his four children, sealing the Spiral Mark with the Willblade, ensuring it could never be used again as a beacon to summon the Nullifiers. [The Spiral Mark] However, Casterwill's best friend was a traitor, known only as the Betrayer, who attempted to reopen the mark using Void, the Nullifier scout. Casterwill's sons and daughters defeated him however, preventing the Nullifiers from returning. [Chasing Void]

Without a common enemy, many Seekers turned to evil. The Casterwill family began to be hunted by the Blood Spiral, a deadly group devoted to bringing back the Nullifiers and wiping out civilization. Many branches were completely wiped out and the remaining members of the family were forced to go into hiding. [The Blood Spiral] Their locations were kept a secret at the Cloisters and guarded by Focauld Casterwill, the keeper of knowledge. [The Casterwill Connection]
 faces Kiel, the Spiral who killed her parents]]
After her parents were killed in fire caused by Kiel at the Paris Casterwill house, Sophie Casterwill was rescued by Santiago and taken to a Casterwill safehouse where she was raised by LeBlanche, the caretaker, before eventually moving to Venice for high school. [Sophie on Trial] As an orphan, now cut from the other branch families, she thought herself to be the sole surviving member of the Casterwill lineage and believed she would never learn the secrets of her family. [Memory Lane] However, she later learnt that her brother, Lucas Casterwill, had also survived but had gone into hiding. [Chasing Void] After speaking to Eathon Lambert and seeing a vision of Lord Casterwill in the Crystal Caves that she discovered that she was, in fact, a direct descendant of the very first Casterwill. [Cave of the Casterwills]
]]
One Casterwill, Teien took a position on the Huntik Foundation Council, but kept her true identity a secret. [The Casterwill Connection] She asked the Huntik team for help to activate the Blue Star to signal to the surviving members of the Casterwill family to come out of hiding and unite against the returning Blood Spiral. Following the quatrains on Eathon's Holotome, Lok Lambert managed to retrieve the Legendary Titan of Summons, Quetzalcoatl and successfully activate the signal. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] However, only a fraction of the family came to the Fortress of Iron Will for the meeting of the Elders. [Sophie on Trial] After a huge battle against a Spiral Army, Sophie won leadership of the Casterwill family after succeeding in the Trial of Courage test to awaken and bond to Mythras, the Legendary Titan of Bravery, defeating Kiel for good in the process. [The Spiral War]

On the longest night of the year, members of the Casterwill family fought side by side with the Huntik Foundation at the Blood Spiral Base, eventually defeating the Blood Spiral. [Lok and the Betrayer] [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Houses of the Casterwill family
sections.text:
*The House of Nobles was led by the parents of Lucas and Sophie Casterwill until they were murdered by Kiel through arson. Lucas became this House's new Elder.[Sophie on Trial]
*The House of Blade Makers was led by its Elder, Nimue Casterwill, the Lady of the Lake, until her sacrifice to hold off the Blood Spirals who were trying to attack the Fortress of Iron Will. Afterwards, Vivian Casterwill inherited the leadership position. [The Spiral War]
*The House of Knowledge is led by its Elder, Focauld Casterwill. [Sophie on Trial]
*The House of Strategists is led by Teien Casterwill. [Sophie on Trial]
*The Elder Rue Guardian oversees his house and the curses that protect the secrets of the Casterwill family. [Sophie on Trial]
